summary: Where agents lists were read in the last five minutes, the roster refresher refolds a forgotten roster at once instead of when the next agents read finds none and waits for it; request latency reports such folds as stage refresh-cold

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: GET /v1/client/request-latency adds stage=refresh-cold to its scope=agents-roster rows; a refresh with no publication to start from now lands there instead of in stage=refresh. Existing fields are unchanged.

recovery.detail: In-memory behavior only; a rollback restores refolding on the next agents read without changing durable state.
